results.text: However, times have since changed and the world has returned to more customary interest rates; we have therefore embarked on a proactive debt-reduction trajectory, which allowed us to reach a leverage level of less than 2x and achieve an Investment Grade rating with our three rating agencies last year. The market gave us credit for this, and the time has come for a more shareholder-friendly policy. For this reason, since 2025, we have distributed all of our free cash ow to simplify it into three parts: acquisitions, dividends and share buybacks. This policy naturally serves to significantly improve EPS, which in turn boosts the stock price. In 2026, we can expect to go even further in this direction, in order, if necessary, to offset all or part of the dilution related to the soft call of the convertible bond. You also moved your headquarters? Headquarters services (approximately 700 people) were spread across two buildings with poor transport connections. We seized a particularly attractive opportunity to move to a single building in La Dfense that is twice the size, for the same rent. All teams are now grouped together in the same place, with the best transport connection hub in le-de-France. It's a huge advantage for working together and recruiting talent. How do you see 2026? The political and economic environment is even more uncertain than in 2025, but we are confident in the strengths and solidity of the Elis model to continue to deliver profitable growth, with continued progress for all the Group's indicators. I would also encourage you to monitor the improvement in EPS in 2026 and 2027, which will mark the transformation of the financial model.
